cases.sentence: На ___ в Кане, в Галилее, был свадебный пир, и мать Иисуса была там.
cases.explain: «третий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

cases.sentence: На третий день в Кане, в Галилее, был ___, и мать Иисуса была там.
cases.explain: «свадебный пир» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

cases.sentence: Рядом стояло шесть больших ___, которые иудеи использовали для обрядовых омовений.
cases.explain: «каменных сосудов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
